definitions: A rhetorical question expressing extreme surprise or disbelief at someone's actions or statements, implying they are irrational or foolish.
Used to challenge someone's judgment when they propose something considered absurd or outrageous.
examples: Have you completely lost your mind this time? You can't seriously think that's a good idea!
When he suggested we climb Mount Everest without any training, I asked, 'Have you completely lost your mind this time?'
She just quit her stable job to become a street performer. Have you completely lost your mind this time?
lemma: have you completely lost your mind this time?
synonyms: are you out of your mind?
source: have you completely lost your mind this time?
